messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — SEV=P1 — autoscaler failing to provision GPUs in azure-koreasouth. Allocation API returning quota errors; queue growth > 3k, tail latency spiking. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-hit

Samir (oncall): ack — jumping in. pinging infra and cloud-eng. Is this a quota denial or transient allocation failure?

Hana (infra): seeing 403 quotaExceeded from Azure ARM when creating VMSS instances. example from allocator logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:14:11Z ERROR allocator: createInstance failed region=azure-koreasouth code=QuotaExceeded message=The requested resource is exhausted for the subscription.
```
Also seeing repeated backoff attempts, autoscaler stuck in reconcile loop.

Lucy (support): Customer impact: a handful of large customers report generation timeouts and 503s for >30m. Support ticket #INC-6921. Notifying affected customers with status page note.

Michael (platform): mitigation options: 1) failover region routing to ap-northeast1 (has spare capacity) 2) move non-SLA pools to CPU-backed fallback (slower but keeps calls alive) 3) temporarily reduce prefork/batch sizes on ingestion pipelines. I can apply routing rule quickly.

Ravi (cloud-eng): contacting Azure suppport now to request quota emergency increase — opening ticket and requesting expedited review. ETA unknown. Also checking subscription-level soft-limits.

Samir (oncall): Michael — please start region reroute for new allocations only (not draining existing). We want to avoid mass reschedules. Hana — can you validate that ap-northeast1 model variants/profiles are compatible for fallback?

Michael (platform): doing the reroute now:
```bash
# switch new allocs from koreasouth -> ap-northeast1 for model-family:redwood-v1
redwoodctl routing set --from=azure-koreasouth --to=ap-northeast1 --models=redwood-v1 --mode=new-allocs --reason="quota emergency"
```
Applying...

ops-bot: action=route-change initiated by Michael (platform) at 2026-03-15T02:20:02Z; links: https://console.redwood/routing/changes/9832

Hana (infra): Confirmed allocator now sends create requests to ap-northeast1 for new pools. Watch for cross-region infra cost/latency but should restore capacity for new requests. Existing queued requests still in koreasouth queue.

Samir (oncall): Lucy — put a short status update to affected customers: we are failing over new allocations to another region, queued requests in koreasouth will be processed as capacity frees or retried to new region. Avoid promising ETA.

Lucy (support): Status update posted to status.redwood.io — note pinned. Ticket INC-6921 updated.

Hana (infra): Additional mitigation — enabling CPU fallback for low-priority jobs. Command:
```json
{"policy":"fallback-to-cpu","priority_threshold":"low","apply_to":"sessionless-inference"}
```
This will keep low-priority workloads from blocking GPU allocation queues. Applying now.

Ravi (cloud-eng): Azure support case opened: 120284-REQ, requesting quota increase for NCas_v4 family in koreasouth. Asked for emergency approval; provided our usage graphs and customer impact. Also starting cross-subscription audit to see if we can reassign unused quota from test subscriptions.

Michael (platform): Implemented temporary throttle on batch size for high-throughput routes to reduce per-request GPU allocation pressure. Patch rolling — will monitor.

Samir (oncall): Update — queue size dropped from 3200 -> 2100 after region reroute + CPU fallback. Tail latency improved slightly. Still seeing some allocation backoffs. Hana — any luck with draining or requeuing?

Hana (infra): We added aggressive retry with jitter for eligible requests and started requeueing long-waiting requests to ap-northeast1 where model compatibility exists. Example log:
```
2026-03-15T02:31:44Z INFO requeueer: migrating 124 requests from queue=koreasouth to region=ap-northeast1
```
This should reduce client timeouts.

Lucy (support): Customers reporting partial recovery. A large customer (Acme AI) still seeing intermittent failures — support is coordinating a direct mitigation (client-side fallback to smaller batch sizes).

Ravi (cloud-eng): Azure responded: initial reply says they see quota consumption spikes and asked for more info. They've escalated to quota team. No firm increase yet.

Samir (oncall): Good work. Next: monitor allocation error rate, queue length, customer 5xx rate. Set a 15m check-in. Hana — if Azure cannot increase quota in the next 30-60m, we'll discuss progressive draining of GPU pools and shifting critical customers to dedicated reserved pools in ap-northeast1.

ops-bot: metric alert suppressed for allocation-errors in koreasouth while mitigations active (suppression window 30m).

(15m later)

Hana (infra): Follow-up: allocation error rate reduced by 70%. Queue now ~900. We are still migrating older queued sessions; some long-running sessions expired and will need client retry.

Samir (oncall): Handing off to Hana for next shift. I'll update incident channel and start post-incident ticket. Handoff notes: Azure quota escalation open (120284-REQ), reroute active, CPU fallback enabled, requeue migration in progress, support already notified customers.

Hana (infra): ACK takeover. Will continue monitoring and keep ops-bot heartbeats every 10m. Creating postmortem stub: https://redwood.internal/incidents/5801234567

Lucy (support): I'll stay on the customer threads until resolved. If any customers need credits/compensation we'll triage with CS.

Ravi (cloud-eng): continuing follow-up with Azure quota team and auditing our subscription usage. If emergency quota not granted, plan B is to shift more capacity to ap-northeast1 and enable longer-term reserved capacity for critical customers.

Michael (platform): Logging change for routing and batch throttle for post-incident review.

Samir (oncall): Thanks everyone. Closing pager for me — handing to Hana. If Azure grants quota bump we'll update and revert routing after a stable window.

Hana (infra): Closing notes at 2026-03-15T03:05:95Z: queue normalized to ~120, allocation errors minimal. Will consolidate logs and write full postmortem.

ops-bot: incident resolved?false severity=P1 current_owner=Hana (infra) started_at=2026-03-15T02:14:11Z
